  PROBLEM STATEMENT:

Traditional farming and security systems often require manual monitoring, which can lead to water wastage, delayed detection of environmental changes, and security risks. Farmers may not know the soil moisture, temperature, gas level, or rainfall condition in real time.  
Therefore, the proposed system aims to develop an IoT-based Smart Farm, Security and Weather Monitoring System using Arduino Uno and ESP8266. The system continuously monitors farm and environmental conditions, provides real-time data through a mobile app/website, automatically controls the water pump and farm motor, and provides RFID/IR-based security alerts.

BLOCK DIAGRAM:

![][image1]

PROJECT IMPLEMENTATION PROCESS:  
1\. Component Setup: Collect and arrange all required sensors, Arduino Uno, ESP8266, and output devices.  
2\. Sensor Interfacing: Connect soil moisture, temperature, gas, rain, RFID, and IR sensors to Arduino Uno.  
3\. Programming & Automation: Program Arduino to monitor conditions and automatically control the water pump and farm motor.  
4\. IoT Connectivity: Connect ESP8266 to enable wireless data transmission through Wi-Fi.  
5\. Dashboard Development: Create a mobile app or website to display real-time data, alerts, and control options.  
6\. Output Integration: Connect the relay, motor driver, LCD, and LEDs for automated control and status indication.  
7\. Testing & Validation: Test sensor readings, irrigation, security alerts, motor control, and IoT communication.

PROPOSED SOLUTION:

The proposed system uses Arduino Uno and ESP8266 to develop an IoT-based smart farm that enables real-time monitoring of soil, weather, and security conditions. It automates irrigation and farm motor operation, detects unauthorized access, and sends live data and alerts to a mobile app or website, reducing water wastage and manual monitoring.
